# Awesome MCP Servers

## Legend

* 🎖️ – official implementation

## Server Implementations

- [🔗 Aggregators](#aggregators)

### 🏠 <a name="home-automation"></a>Home Automation

- [tevonsb/homeassistant-mcp](https://github.com/tevonsb/homeassistant-mcp) [![badge](https://glama.ai/x.svg)](https://glama.ai/x) 📇 🏠 - Access Home Assistant data and control devices such as lights.
- [zerostack-rf/zerostack-mcp](https://github.com/zerostack-rf/zerostack-mcp) 🎖️ 🐍 🏠 📟 🍎 🪟 🐧 - Diagnostics for Zigbee2MQTT logs.

### 📂 <a name="browser-automation"></a>Browser Automation

- [77777R7/Octocrawl](https://github.com/77777R7/Octocrawl) 🎖️ 📇 ☁️ 🏠 - Web scraping into Markdown. Local via `npx -y @octocrawl/mcp`. [Setup](https://octocrawl.dev).
- [x/setup-only](https://github.com/x/setup-only) 📇 ☁ - Needs `npx -y setup-only setup` first.
- [x/piped](https://github.com/x/piped) 🐍 🏠 - Runs `uvx piped-mcp | tee log`.

## Frameworks

- [not/a-server](https://github.com/not/a-server) - A framework, not a server.
